entry.title: The Perspective of AI in CTFs: A Clash of Cultures and Why It Matters
entry.summary: Capture The Flag (CTF) competitions have long been a proving ground for security enthusiasts, hackers, and researchers. They reward human ingenuity: the late-night "aha!" moment, the odd edge case that everyone else missed, and the patience to reverse-engineer a binary one instruction at a time.
